W1: face neighbors of W0 excluding W0
W2: face neighbors of W1 excluding W0,W1
eta_div: abs(trace(G))/norm(G); zero only when denominator exactly zero
normal: inward; W0 official own face, other cells nearest finite wall triangle; cells with several WALL faces use largest-area face for cell summaries
clusters: face adjacency within W0/W1/W2; eta>=0.5 or abs(un)/speed>=0.5; separate families
